description: Dylan Hunt awakens three centuries after the fall of the Systems Commonwealth and turns a salvage crew into the beginning of a new High Guard. As Beka, Harper, Trance, Tyr and Rev Bem learn to function together aboard Andromeda, Dylan gathers the first worlds for a restored Commonwealth and discovers that the Magog threat is far larger than anyone imagined.

s01e01.description: Dylan Hunt and the Andromeda are trapped near a black hole during the Commonwealth's fall, only to be pulled free by salvagers three centuries later.

s01e02.description: Dylan fights to retake the Andromeda from Gerentex and convinces the stranded salvage crew to help him escape the black hole.

s01e03.description: The crew discovers an old High Guard station inhabited by descendants who have turned its weapons and legends into a dangerous way of life.

s01e04.description: An attack by an unknown enemy exposes the new crew's uncertainty over command, trust and how Dylan intends to run the ship.

s01e05.description: Tyr is tempted by a Nietzschean colony offering him status, family and a future if he abandons Dylan and the Andromeda.

s01e06.description: A slipstream accident throws the Andromeda back to the decisive battle that destroyed the Commonwealth, forcing the crew to preserve history without understanding it fully.

s01e07.description: Beka's unreliable brother arrives with Wayist companions whose apparent mission conceals a more destructive agenda.

s01e08.description: A black-hole experiment lets Dylan contact his fiancée Sara across three centuries and briefly offers him a path back to the life he lost.

s01e09.description: Dylan and Rommie are imprisoned on a sealed penal colony while the rest of the crew searches for a way to rescue them.

s01e10.description: A visiting Commonwealth chancellor is murdered aboard Andromeda, leaving Tyr under suspicion and Dylan forced to solve the killing.

s01e11.description: Beka answers a plea from her old family friend Sid and discovers his success is tied to the addictive drug Flash.

s01e12.description: The crew boards the derelict High Guard ship Pax Magellanic and uncovers a three-hundred-year-old disaster involving its immortal crew and unstable AI.

s01e13.description: An amnesiac Tyr is stranded among settlers while Nietzscheans hunt both him and the cargo he had been carrying.

s01e14.description: A dying Perseid downloads a vast store of knowledge into Harper's brain, making him brilliant, sleepless and the target of a determined pursuer.

s01e15.description: Dylan is arrested over an assassination from three centuries earlier and must confront the political consequences of an old High Guard mission.

s01e16.description: A machine intelligence from the Consensus of Parts attempts to absorb Rommie and draw the Andromeda into its collective.

s01e17.description: Gerentex forces Harper and Trance to help him locate a route to Tarn-Vedra, the legendary lost capital of the Commonwealth.

s01e18.description: Dylan and Rev help a peaceful society resist slavers while wrestling with the danger of teaching violence to a people whose descendants inherit memory.

s01e19.description: Dylan escorts a Nietzschean bride whose arranged marriage is meant to unite rival prides, only to discover that the political bargain is not what it seems.

s01e20.description: Rommie falls for a rescued android whose connection to an insane warship AI turns the relationship into a threat to Andromeda.

s01e21.description: Beka tries to follow a map to Tarn-Vedra and pushes herself into dangerous dependence on stimulants as the route grows increasingly difficult.

s01e22.description: A restored backup personality makes Andromeda believe she is still on a secret mission from centuries earlier, just as the Magog threat reaches the ship.
